image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a printed paper menu. The text is heavily distorted and illegible, resembling 'gibberish' or AI-generated hallucinations of typography rather than real words. There are decorative floral/scrollwork elements at the bottom which appear somewhat fused with the text area. The lighting is uneven, with a greenish tint.

The floral/scroll designs lack sharp edges and appear to bleed slightly into the white space, typical of diffusion model artifacts.
The lines of text do not follow a consistent vanishing point or plane; they warp and wave unnaturally across the page.
